messages:
jamie_support: FYI customer reporting immediate 401 invalid_api_key after rotating keys.
jamie_support: Paste from user: curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-test-abc123def456 # created for demo\" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
jamie_support: They say it worked before rotation, now fails.
alex_csm: which customer? do we have request-id from their attempt?
jamie_support: customer: @AcmeAI (internal ticket 4621). They included request-id in screenshot: rq_01G4X2Y8Z. I pulled gateway logs for that id.
ryan_engineer: grabbed the gateway log for rq_01G4X2Y8Z — incoming header shows Authorization value literally contains a hash and comment. remote_addr 34.125.88.12
ryan_engineer: log snippet:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-test-abc123def456 # created for demo
```
ryan_engineer: We treat the token string strictly; anything after the token invalidates signature in our key lookup -> 401 invalid_api_key
alex_csm: so they rotated but the client copied the example including the trailing comment. Oof.
jamie_support: asked customer to paste exact header contents from their app. They replied with a screenshot of a shell script where the key is set like: export REDWOOD_KEY=\"sk-test-abc123def456 # created for demo\"
jamie_support: recommended they remove the comment or put it on a new line: `export REDWOOD_KEY=sk-test-abc123def456  # comment` (space before # still part of value in some shells unless unquoted)
ryan_engineer: quick repro on my laptop:
```
$ curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer 'sk-test-abc123def456 # comment'\" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"invalid_api_key"}
```
ryan_engineer: after trimming the trailing comment it succeeds.
jamie_support: sent fix instructions to customer: 1) remove trailing comment from the env var (unquote or escape), 2) restart service to pick up new env var, 3) test with short curl snippet we provided. waiting on confirmation.
alex_csm: also reminded them to revoke the test key if it leaked into repos/screenshots.
deploy-bot: deploy notice: config-change detected for acmeai/staging — restart executed at 2026-03-15T14:45:02Z
jamie_support: customer confirmed they removed comment and restarted, tests now return 200. closing the support thread and marking as user error (copy/paste from docs). adding note to docs to show a comment-free example.
ryan_engineer: opened a tiny docs PR to add a \"do not copy the trailing comment\" callout.
jamie_support: closing — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
